title: Communications Executive
description:
Communications Executive

We are seeking a commercially minded Communications Executive to join a logistics marketing team, supporting the company's reputation, commercial objectives and corporate communications across internal and external channels.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in PR or communications who can produce high-quality written content, identify compelling stories and deliver communications activity independently within a fast-paced commercial environment.

Benefits include a salary of 28,000- 32,0000, pension contribution scheme, death-in-service benefit, annual leave, employee rewards scheme, wellness and mental health assistance.

Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver press releases, thought leadership articles, case studies and other corporate communications content.
- Identify newsworthy stories and relevant PR opportunities to promote company expertise, achievements and industry insight.
- Support proactive media engagement, building and maintaining relationships with journalists, publications and relevant industry contacts.
- Coordinate industry award submissions, gathering supporting information and producing compelling entries.
- Deliver internal communications, including company announcements, leadership updates and employee communications.
- Work closely with Sales, Operations and other departments to identify stories, gather information and ensure communications accurately reflect business activity.
- Maintain consistent corporate messaging across internal and external communications, in line with brand guidelines.
- Monitor and report on PR and communications activity, identifying opportunities to improve reach, engagement and effectiveness.
- Manage day-to-day communications activity independently, ensuring content is accurate, engaging and delivered to deadlines.

About You
- Practical experience in a PR, communications or related role, with a proven ability to produce high-quality written content for different audiences.
- Experience in B2 B communications or the logistics sector would be advantageous.
- Excellent written English, with strong copywriting, editing and proofreading skills.
- Experience producing press releases, case studies and thought leadership content, alongside an understanding of media relations.
- Ability to identify newsworthy stories and translate complex information into clear, compelling communications.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage with colleagues, senior stakeholders, journalists and external contacts.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage priorities.
- Proactive, resourceful and commercially aware, with the initiative, curiosity and judgement to identify opportunities and develop new ideas.
- Resilient and adaptable, with the tenacity and work ethic to operate effectively in a fast-moving commercial environment.

title: Content & Social Media Specialist
description:
Are you a creative, commercially minded content professional who knows how to make a B2 B brand stand out? Join Burgess & Hodgson and take ownership of content that brings expertise to life, builds our profile and delivers measurable results.

Content & Social Media Specialist

Canterbury Office-based
- Competitive salary, depending on experience
- Full-time, Monday to Friday, 9am-5.30pm

About Us

At Burgess & Hodgson, we want our online presence to reflect the quality of the firm behind it. Our small, ambitious marketing team works closely with partners and directors to share their expertise, tell client stories and create content that connects with our audience.

We're looking for a Content & Social Media Specialist who enjoys owning their work from start to finish, combining writing and design with strategy, scheduling and reporting.

About the Role

This is a varied, hands-on opportunity to shape how Burgess & Hodgson shows up online. You'll work across written, visual and video content, helping us maintain a consistent brand and turn marketing activity into meaningful outcomes.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Writing compelling, technically sound copy for social media, email, web and campaigns, turning partner expertise, client stories and market insights into engaging content while maintaining a consistent brand voice across all digital touchpoints.
- Planning, writing and delivering HubSpot email campaigns aligned with wider marketing activity, monitoring results and recommending improvements to engagement and conversion.
- Managing our social channels day to day, including LinkedIn and Instagram, owning the content calendar, scheduling posts, monitoring engagement, responding where appropriate and growing our visibility and relevance.
- Shooting and editing short-form video for social and digital channels, and creating graphics and visual assets using Adobe InDesign, Canva and other design tools, involving external suppliers for larger production projects where needed.
- Using HubSpot to track campaign activity, manage workflows and maintain accurate data, working with our Growth Operations Manager to build reports, analyse performance and turn findings into clear recommendations.
- Keeping our WordPress website fresh, accurate and on-brand, writing and optimising content to implement our external agency's SEO and GEO recommendations, understanding how search engines and AI tools surface information, and sharing analytics insights with the team and agency.
- Supporting digital campaigns, events and announcements, working closely with partners and directors to develop content that reflects their expertise and strengthens the firm's profile and reputation.
- Briefing and liaising with external SEO, design and production agencies to deliver work on time, while organising your workload and contributing reliably to a small team where everyone's output matters.

About You

You'll be a creative, self-directed content professional with commercial awareness and the confidence to take ideas through to delivery. You understand how content supports business outcomes and enjoy working collaboratively in a small, fast-moving team.

You'll bring:
- At least three years' experience in a content or social media role, owning the function end to end, ideally within B2 B or professional services.
- Exceptional copywriting skills and an understanding of how to write for a business audience.
- Confidence creating written, visual and video content.
- Experience using HubSpot, Adobe InDesign, WordPress and Google Analytics.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
- A collaborative approach and the ability to work independently.
- Availability to work in our Canterbury office Monday to Friday, 9am-5.30pm.

How to Apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Content & Social Media Specialist position based in Canterbury, click "apply" today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

No agencies please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Content Marketing Specialist, Social Media Manager, Content Marketing Executive, Digital Marketing Executive, Social Media Executive, Content Creator, Marketing Communications Executive, B2 B Copywriter, Email Marketing Executive, Digital Content Specialist.

title: Content Manager
description:
A growing digital agency is looking for an experienced Content Manager to lead content strategy, planning, and delivery across a portfolio of client accounts. This is a hands-on role combining creative storytelling, SEO, audience insights, and data-driven decision-making to drive organic visibility, engagement, and commercial results. This is a hybrid position and perfect for someone who is wanting to step into a more senior role who is looking to grow professionally with a supportive and talented team.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver content strategies aligned to client objectives and performance targets.
- Manage the content creation process from research and briefing through to publishing and optimisation.
- Produce and review high-quality content, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and strong brand messaging.
- Collaborate with SEO, Digital PR, Creative, and Growth teams to deliver integrated campaigns.
- Analyse content performance and audience insights to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.
- Build strong client relationships, present strategies and results, and identify opportunities to expand accounts.
- Support and mentor junior team members, helping maintain high standards across content delivery.
- Leverage AI and industry-leading tools to improve efficiency while maintaining content quality.

What we need from you:
- Proven experience in content marketing, content strategy, and SEO-led content within an agency or fast-paced environment.
- Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills.
- Strong understanding of SEO, search trends, content performance metrics, and audience behaviour.
- Confident managing client relationships and presenting strategic recommendations.
- Commercially aware, with experience managing budgets, KPIs, and account growth opportunities.
- Passionate about emerging trends in AI, search, social media, and digital content.

What Success Looks Like
- Delivering high-performing content strategies that increase visibility, engagement, and conversions.
- Building trusted client relationships that drive retention and growth.
- Producing consistently high-quality content and campaign outcomes.
- Supporting a collaborative, innovative, and high-performing team culture.

The role comes with a brilliant package from 28 days holiday, private healthcare and a 4 day working week. If you would like to find out more then get in touch ASAP!

title: Digital Marketing Executive
company: Diamond Search Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

Recruitment Agency: Diamond Search Recruitment
Location: Tunbridge Wells - Hybrid
Salary: £35 K plus great benefits!
Job Type: Full-time

About the Opportunity

Diamond Search Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting for a Digital Marketing Executive on behalf of a well-established professional services organisation. This is an excellent opportunity for a creative, digitally minded marketing professional to join a collaborative Business Development and Marketing team and play an important role in enhancing the organisation s digital presence.

Working closely with the Marketing and Communications Manager, you will support the delivery of digital marketing campaigns across the website, social media, email marketing, video content and online advertising. You will have the opportunity to combine creativity with analytical thinking, helping to build brand awareness, engage audiences, increase website traffic and generate new business opportunities.

This role would suit someone with digital marketing experience who enjoys creating engaging content, exploring new digital trends and using performance insights to improve campaign results.

Key Responsibilities

Website & SEO
- Manage and update website content, supporting website development and user experience improvements.
- Assist with campaign landing pages and digital content publishing.
- Work with external agencies to implement SEO recommendations.
- Monitor website performance, analyse results and report against key performance indicators.
- Support colleagues with website content management and promote best practice.

Social Media & Content Creation
- Manage and monitor social media channels to increase brand awareness and engagement.
- Develop and maintain a social media content calendar.
- Create, schedule and publish engaging, accurate and timely content across relevant platforms.
- Monitor performance and identify opportunities to improve reach and engagement.
- Provide guidance to colleagues on social media best practice and emerging trends.

Video Production & Editing
- Support the planning, filming and editing of video content for digital campaigns, social media, the website, email marketing and events.
- Produce engaging multimedia content, incorporating captions, graphics, music and brand elements.
- Adapt video content for different platforms and ensure accessibility standards are met.
- Maintain an organised library of digital assets and use performance insights to improve future content.

Email Marketing
- Create and deliver targeted email marketing campaigns in line with agreed marketing plans.
- Build and test email campaigns, checking copy, links, formatting and audience segmentation before launch.
- Analyse campaign performance and recommend improvements.
- Maintain and optimise email templates.
- Support colleagues with marketing technology, including ClickDimensions.

Digital Advertising & Campaign Performance
- Work with external agencies to support Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing) campaigns.
- Assist with paid social media campaign delivery and optimisation.
- Monitor enquiries generated through digital campaigns and help assess lead quality and outcomes.
- Identify opportunities to improve targeting, engagement and advertising performance.

Wider Marketing Support
- Help maintain consistent branding and visual identity across all digital channels.
- Collaborate with colleagues, internal stakeholders and external agencies.
- Share ideas and recommendations to improve digital marketing activity and overall performance.
- Support the wider Business Development and Marketing function as required.

About You

You will be a proactive and creative digital marketer with a strong eye for detail, excellent communication skills and a genuine interest in developing your digital marketing expertise.

Essential experience and skills:

At least two years experience in a digital marketing role.

Experience supporting campaigns across websites, email marketing, social media and online advertising.

Working knowledge of content management systems, ideally WordPress, alongside Google Analytics and SEO tools.

Experience using email marketing platforms and social media management tools.

Strong copywriting and digital content creation skills, including image and video editing.

Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva or similar tools.

Good analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and recommend practical improvements.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.

A collaborative approach, combined with the confidence to work independently and take initiative.

Desirable:

Experience within a professional services or B2 B environment.

Familiarity with CRM systems and marketing automation platforms, particularly ClickDimensions.

A marketing degree or professional marketing qualification, ideally with a digital marketing focus.

GCSEs or equivalent in English and Mathematics are required as a minimum. Graduate-level education is preferred but not essential.

Additional Requirements

The role may involve attending events and meetings in London and other regional locations.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to develop your digital marketing career within a collaborative professional environment, working across a varied mix of creative content, digital campaigns, website optimisation, email marketing and paid advertising.

You will be able to contribute ideas, develop your technical skills and see the impact of your work across a range of digital channels.

Apply Today

If you are a creative and commercially minded digital marketer looking for your next opportunity, Diamond Search Recruitment would love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV to be considered for this exciting Digital Marketing Executive opportunity.

Diamond Search Recruitment is managing this recruitment process on behalf of its client.

title: Digital Marketing Manager (B2C)
description:
Are you bursting with fresh ideas and excited by the opportunity to make a genuine impact? We're looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Digital Marketing Manager to take ownership of our ecommerce and marketing function, helping to drive growth, identify new opportunities and shape the future direction of our business.

Reporting into senior leadership, you'll lead the digital marketing strategy with a particular focus on ecommerce performance, online sales growth and brand visibility. This is a broad, hands-on role where you'll take ownership of the ecommerce website, digital acquisition activity, social media channels and customer lifecycle marketing.

If you're someone who thrives on turning ideas into measurable outcomes, enjoys working collaboratively across a business and wants to make a genuine difference, we'd love to hear from you.

- Own and optimise the ecommerce website, ensuring an excellent customer experience and maximising conversion rates.

About You

You'll likely have:
- Experience in a Digital Marketing Manager, Ecommerce Manager or Growth Marketing role.
- Proven experience managing and optimising an ecommerce website, ideally Shopify.
- A strong understanding of ecommerce trading, online customer journeys, conversion rate optimisation and digital acquisition channels.
- Experience managing social media channels and creating strategies that drive engagement and growth.
- Hands-on experience with Klaviyo, CRM and email marketing.
- Knowledge of Paid Media, SEO and performance marketing.
- Strong analytical skills and experience using ecommerce and marketing data to make commercial decisions.
- Previous leadership or team management experience.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable:
- Experience working with or managing TikTok Shop.
- Experience within a B2 C ecommerce environment.
- Knowledge of influencer or creator-led marketing campaigns.

Benefits

In return for your expertise, you'll receive:
- Hybrid working, with a blend of office and home-based working.
- The opportunity to take ownership of a key business function and make a genuine impact.
- Excellent career development prospects within a growing business.
- Autonomy to shape strategy, influence decision-making and bring your ideas to life.
- Exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to contribute to wider business growth plans.
- A collaborative and supportive team environment where your ideas will be valued.
- The chance to lead, mentor and develop a small marketing team.

Apply now!

title: Retail Social Media Manager
description:
I am recruiting for a Social Media Manager on behalf of a premium consumer retail business that is looking to elevate its social media presence and build highly engaged communities across multiple brands.

This opportunity would suit someone from a retail, ecommerce, or consumer brand background who understands how social media can drive both brand awareness and commercial performance. You'll be confident creating content and comfortable being in front of the camera, whether that's presenting products, interviewing guests, or developing engaging social-first video content.

A key focus of the role will be the exciting opportunity to launch and grow the company's TikTok presence, developing a platform strategy from the ground up and creating content that resonates with new and existing audiences.

Working closely with the wider marketing team, you'll own the organic social strategy, manage creator partnerships, and use insights and performance data to continually improve results.

Key Responsibilities

Own and deliver the social media strategy across consumer, trade, and brand channels.

Create engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.

Appear on camera and develop social-first video content.

Launch and grow the company's TikTok channel and community.

Manage influencer and creator partnerships.

Build engaged online communities through proactive community management.

Track performance, report on key metrics, and identify growth opportunities.

Collaborate with marketing, ecommerce, and commercial teams to support wider business objectives.

What we need from you:

Proven experience managing organic social media channels for a consumer-facing brand.

Demonstrable success growing engaged audiences and communities.

Experience working within a direct-to-consumer ecommerce business, premium retailer, or consumer brand.

Strong content creation skills, particularly across short-form video and social-first content.

Strong understanding of social media analytics and reporting tools.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge of social media management platforms such as Sprout Social.

Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools.

Experience managing multiple brands with distinct audiences and brand voices

This is a hybrid position with 2 days in the office so you must be able to drive to Tonbridge for the 2 roles. If you are interested in the role then please apply ASAP!
